allow: Bash(gh api repos/:owner/:repo/pulls/$(gh pr view --json number --jq .number)/comments:*)

hooks.command: [ -n "$CMUX_SURFACE_ID" ] && command -v cmux >/dev/null 2>&1 && { i=$(cat); printf '%s' "$i" | cmux claude-hook notification; m=$(printf '%s' "$i" | jq -r '.message // empty' 2>/dev/null); case "$m" in *"waiting for your input"*) : ;; *) cmux set-progress 0.5 --label waiting >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; } || true
/Applications/Adrafinil.app/Contents/Helpers/adrafinil release $CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID --tool claude-code
~/.claude/hooks/dependency-assess-reminder.sh
[ -n "$CMUX_SURFACE_ID" ] && command -v cmux >/dev/null 2>&1 && cmux set-progress 0.5 --label working >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
~/.claude/hooks/prefer-rg-fd.sh
~/.claude/hooks/no-poll-loops.sh
~/.claude/hooks/prefer-python3.sh
~/.claude/hooks/rtk-rewrite.sh
~/.claude/hooks/sonar-secrets/build-scripts/pretool-secrets.sh
[ -n "$CMUX_SURFACE_ID" ] && command -v cmux >/dev/null 2>&1 && cmux clear-progress >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
/Applications/Adrafinil.app/Contents/Helpers/adrafinil release $CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID --tool claude-code
[ -n "$CMUX_SURFACE_ID" ] && command -v cmux >/dev/null 2>&1 && cmux claude-hook session-start || true
[ -n "$CMUX_SURFACE_ID" ] && command -v cmux >/dev/null 2>&1 && cmux clear-progress >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
/Applications/Adrafinil.app/Contents/Helpers/adrafinil acquire $CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID --tool claude-code

[ -n "$CMUX_SURFACE_ID" ] && command -v cmux >/dev/null 2>&1 && { cmux claude-hook stop; cmux set-progress 1.0 --label done >/dev/null 2>&1; (~/dotfiles/bin/cmux-pr-titles >/dev/null 2>&1 &); } || true
/Applications/Adrafinil.app/Contents/Helpers/adrafinil release $CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID --tool claude-code
/Applications/Adrafinil.app/Contents/Helpers/adrafinil acquire --tool claude-code --subagent
/Applications/Adrafinil.app/Contents/Helpers/adrafinil release --tool claude-code --subagent
[ -n "$CMUX_SURFACE_ID" ] && command -v cmux >/dev/null 2>&1 && { cmux claude-hook prompt-submit; cmux set-progress 0.01 --label working >/dev/null 2>&1; } || true
~/.claude/hooks/sonar-secrets/build-scripts/prompt-secrets.sh
/Applications/Adrafinil.app/Contents/Helpers/adrafinil acquire $CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID --tool claude-code
